decision.title: The website: sxml.tinyactors.dev on GitHub Pages

body.p: , at the owner's request, after the repository moved to tinyactors-dev/sxml.

item.p: The site is a VitePress landing page in website/ (what sxml is, its design rules, streaming, conformance, where it runs) with the book at /book/, built by mdbook beside it. mise run site builds both into build/site. Every claim on the landing page is the README's (Conformance, Design, Examples); change them together. Its pipeline example (website/pipeline/) checks a coding agent's TypeScript against the rules of an AGENTS.md: sxml:parse-code and Invisible XML read the rules, XSD checks them, XPath and XQuery find violations in the syntax trees, and XSLT writes the message a hook gives the agent. Its AGENTS.md is example data, not instructions for this repository. node website/pipeline/run.mjs re-runs it with the release build and records the outputs the page shows.
The look is the tinyactors design system (vellum, graphite, pine; Newsreader and IBM Plex, self-hosted in website/public/fonts/). docs/book/style/ gives the book the same colours and type.

Hosting: mise run site:publish (tools/publish-site.sh) builds the site locally and force-pushes it as one commit to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves under the custom domain in website/public/CNAME. No GitHub Actions: they are off (), so whoever changes website/ or the book publishes by hand.
